detail.longDescription: One more thought before I call it a night. There's only so much begging one can do before lashing out at those continuing to ignore the harm they cause. Especially when they've been spoonfed proof of that harm as respectfully as possible and still don't care. While I don't want any useless bile to be thrown towards open source projects that allow AI, its remarkably dense to cry about being shouted at when you are still punching so many people square in the face after they already complained about their broken jaws. #Anti-ai #ai #no-ai #foss #llm #open-source #fuck-ai
